description: Reads Development's Errors page: each refusal code with its count, first and last seen, the newest refusal's own sentence, an example Logs row id (dev_logs reads the row), and the page that explains the code (https://docs.gemmein.com/errors/<code>). The last 7 days, or the last `hours` (1–168); up to 50 codes. Useful for finding why something in Development was refused. Development only — never Live (live_errors reads Live); changes nothing; each read is on the founder's Logs.
name: dev_errors
title: Development: errors
